subject: Geopolitics
title: The 1973 Oil Embargo
description: A quick win: understand The 1973 Oil Embargo.

hook.text: Arab nations cut oil exports to the US and allies after the 1973 Yom Kippur War. Prices quadrupled in three months.

buildup.text: Gas stations ran out of fuel. Americans waited hours in line. The world's richest nation was held hostage by oil.

discovery.text: The embargo proved that energy producers could weaponize supply. It rewrote the rules of international power.

twist.text: The shock spurred conservation, fuel efficiency, and renewable research. Pain created incentives that persist today.

climax.text: 1973 showed the world that energy dependence is a strategic vulnerability. Every energy policy since traces back to it.

punchline.text: One embargo changed how the world thinks about energy forever.

quiz.question: What lasting effect did the 1973 oil embargo have?
options: It spurred energy conservation and diversification
It ended US involvement in Middle East politics
